description: This file contains internal transport flow control logic for gRPC, including classes and methods for managing flow control windows, quotas, and data flow for streams.

classes.name: writeQuota
classes.description: Manages quota for stream data, including replenishment and synchronization.

classes.name: trInFlow
classes.description: Handles inbound flow control, managing window size and data acknowledgment.

classes.name: inFlow
classes.description: Manages inbound flow control with window updates, pending data, and flow adjustments.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a writeQuota instance with size and done channel.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Attempts to acquire quota; waits if quota is not available.

methods.name: realReplenish
methods.description: Replenishes quota and signals availability if quota becomes positive.

methods.name: onData
methods.description: Updates flow control state upon receiving data, returns error if limit exceeded.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets unacknowledged data counter and updates effective window size.

methods.name: updateEffectiveWindowSize
methods.description: Updates the effective window size based on current limit and unacknowledged data.

methods.name: maybeAdjust
methods.description: Adjusts window size based on data and flow state, returns delta for window update.

methods.name: onRead
methods.description: Handles data read by application, updates pending data and window update size.
